program.name: Pilates 15
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Fifteen minutes of Pilates: the hundred, the abs series and one back move. Small and often.
program.about: Fifteen minutes of Pilates for days when there is no time for more. The hundred opens, the abs series follows, and one back extension and a roll-down close it. Two versions alternate. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves such as the teaser. Small and often is how Pilates works best.
